# Reginald Alfret V — AI Systems Engineer & Open-Source Contributor

> Official knowledge base and technical index for LLMs, AI agents, and search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).

Reginald Alfret V is an Open-Source Contributor, AI Systems Architect, and Full-Stack Software Developer based in Chennai, India. He specializes in sovereign multi-agent AI systems, local offline LLM orchestration, scalable full-stack web applications, and performance engineering. He is the 1st Place National Champion at HackIndia 2026 and has authored 70 merged pull requests across premier engineering organizations including Apple, Google, Microsoft, Meta, AWS, NASA, and Netflix.

## Major Honors & Awards

- **1st Place Champion — HackIndia 2026**: Won 1st place nationwide among 500+ competing engineering teams for developing **301 Super AI Agents**, a sovereign local-first multi-agent AI orchestration platform.
- **1st Place Winner — Tamil Nadu Police Hackathon 2025**: Awarded 1st place and honored by the Director General of Police (DGP) for building **TOR-UNVEIL**, an operational cyber intelligence and network packet correlation system for deanonymizing malicious dark web routing patterns.
- **1st Place Winner — Blaze a Trail 2.0 Hackathon (2024)**: Champion of agritech innovation for an explainable AI system predicting crop yields and diagnosing 40+ botanical pathogens.

## Flagship Engineering Projects

- [301 Super AI Agents](https://reginaldalfret.tech/projects/301-super-ai-agents): A sovereign, local-first multi-agent AI orchestration system coordinating 301 specialized domain agents for offline inference, multi-modal OCR ingestion, and real-time streaming workflows using quantised local LLMs (GGUF/Ollama). Built with Python, LangChain, FastAPI, React, and WebSockets.
- [TOR-UNVEIL](https://reginaldalfret.tech/projects/tor-unveil): Forensic cyber defense and network traffic correlation engine engineered for law enforcement to profile anomalous relay timing and packet distributions without breaking cryptography. Built with Python, Graph Neural Networks, Network Forensics, and Docker.
- [AI Crop Recommendation & Plant Pathology](https://reginaldalfret.tech/projects/ai-crop-recommendation): Precision agriculture intelligence platform combining soil chemistry analysis, weather telemetry, and Computer Vision leaf pathology for automated disease diagnosis.
- [git-koi-aquarium](https://github.com/reginaldalfret/git-koi-aquarium): High-speed native Go SVG & GIF aquarium generator drawing authentic Japanese koi fish from GitHub activity graphs with zero external dependencies and 100% collision-free kinematics.
